source_kind: Single frame from the recorded real-time RViz video
crop_rule: Retain the entire station, full planned route, executed trajectory up to this frame and field-of-view frustum in the global panel; retain the complete displayed camera image. Remove only interface controls, overlays and empty margins.
pixel_operations: Rectangular crops only; no brightness, contrast, gamma, recoloring, or generated content. Spatial dimensions and aspect ratios are preserved.
selection: One frame during the transfer from observation 9 to 10, selected to show central-module detail absent from the terminal camera panels in Figure 7. Both panels remain synchronized to this single video frame.

frame_state.timing_note: Mission time estimated from recorded video/event alignment; 24 s after the previous accepted observation and within the 90 s transfer. Counts use the last credited event before this frame.
